Looking at the metrics, I see baseline at 15:29 around 1000 IOPS and 15.6 MiB/s with sub-millisecond latencies, then a sharp drop to about 42 IOPS during 15:31-15:44.

# Mitigation Summary

## Action
Add the CloudWatch alarm ebs-skill-eval-d-gp3-queue-length as a stop condition on FIS experiment template EXTfpFLs9urWUme, after confirming that no experiment from this template is running. Do not change the volume's IOPS or throughput.

## Reasoning
FIS experiment EXP7SDntcG3Ff1fsx (template EXTfpFLs9urWUme) injected 500 ms of I/O latency into vol-0123456789abcdef0_2 for 15 minutes. That pinned the queue at ~16 and caused the alarm from 15:33 to 15:47Z. The earlier run EXP4Xs8yABzn38YDgv caused the same alarm. The template still has stopConditions source=none, so every future run will degrade the volume for the full 15 minutes. No experiment is running, so the template can be changed safely now. Raising IOPS was ruled out: the volume used ~1.4% of its IOPS and ~0.5% of its throughput.
